act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: COB 8.5.13(2) and the 16.2 table use the undefined 'Insurance Bank Account'
en.summary: COB 8.5 requires Client Money to be held in "Client Money Accounts" (8.5.6, 8.5.9). COB 8.5.13(2) requires records of "all sums withdrawn from the Insurance Bank Account as a result of credit taken under COB 8.5.12", and the table in COB 16.2 repeats it. "Insurance Bank Account" is not defined in COB or in the Glossary and is used nowhere else. The term has been in COB since the first version (then COB 11.8.12). The meaning (the Client Money Account) can be recovered from 8.5.9 and 8.5.12.
en.correction: Please replace "Insurance Bank Account" with "Client Money Account" in COB 8.5.13(2) and in the table in COB 16.2.
